packageRules.description: web/ is deployed on Vercel; its engines.node pins the Vercel build runtime and may only move to a Node major Vercel supports. Bump it by hand.

str0m is held below 0.25: under 0.25 a native answerer behind an address-restricted NAT never starts its own ICE checks, which broke the natsim NAT'd-anchor rows (two natsim_natted_anchor_* tests). Lift this only with those rows green on the natsim job.
